title: Customer Data Analysis
description: Sample analytics case study exploring customer segments, purchasing patterns and business indicators using structured data.
objective: Demonstrate how data can be cleaned, queried and analyzed to identify patterns that support practical business decisions.
steps: Reviewed the available customer and transaction fields.
Checked data quality and prepared the dataset for analysis.
Grouped records into meaningful customer segments.
Analyzed purchasing patterns and summary indicators.
Presented the main observations in concise analytical outputs.
results: Produced a sample customer analysis workflow showing how structured data can be transformed into useful business insights.
